generate_expression: generate a modular arithmetic expression with brackets and its computed result given a modulus and length
create_dataset: create a dataset of modular arithmetic expressions with brackets and their integer results for training
build_task: build a ModularArithmeticBrackets generalization task with a specified modulus and optional multiplication operator
sample_batch: sample a batch of one-hot encoded input expressions and output results for a given length and batch size
test_modulus: test the input and output size properties of a ModularArithmeticBrackets task instance
